Set an identification string for the exported TVPX file, internally in the TVPX file.§

Here's an example : you make a panel containing a few brushes, you export it and give it the identification number "My_Brushes", and the name "My Brushes 1.0". 
When you decide to update it, you keep the identification "My_Brushes", and as you have updated it, you name it "My Brushes 1.1".

So, when someone will install it, TVPaint Animation will look if an existing panel has the same identification number, 
and if it founds one, it will consider that we are installing an update.

The Timeline Notes.§

The aim of this feature is to allow the user
to add some comments/remarks/ideas/suggestions/notes
over the animation on which he is working.
This Timeline Notes part is only a help for the animator,
they are played over the project window at the same
time than the animation is played in the software.
Of course, they won't be added in the final
animation render.
